summary: Iteration 25 review of the six changes shipped by main agent: photo de-duplication, relevant-sort spread + cold-start popular fallback, tracking +3d/+7d ESTIMATED tail with country-only Delivery, JSONCargo 24h TTL, header balance, and detail-page gallery geometry. 8/8 pytest passed. Frontend: header, sort dropdown, gallery, language switch, and tracking milestones all verified in the browser. ONE spec deviation found: the /track summary card DOES print the container number when by=bol (data-testid='track-container-no' at TrackPage.js:401-409), which contradicts the acceptance criterion 'the page must NOT show the container ID anywhere — only the Bill of Lading'. Everything else matches spec.

ui_bugs.issue: When by='bol', the card still renders 'Container MRSU5757040 · 40' Dry High' below the Bill-of-Lading number (data-testid='track-container-no'). Spec: 'the page must NOT show the container ID anywhere — only the Bill of Lading'. Either drop the whole track-container-no block when data.by==='bol' (or unconditionally), or gate it behind an admin-only flag.

action_items: Hide the container number on /track when the reference is looked up by Bill of Lading: remove or conditionally render TrackPage.js lines 401-409 (the `data.container && data.container !== data.reference` block) so buyers only ever see the BoL. Verified location is Bergen Op Zoom, milestone dates and 'est.' badges are correct — this is the only spec miss.

Spot-checked 8 more listings from /api/search — none had duplicate URLs.

backend/server.py popular_ids() cold-start (empty taste): fallback returns 24 items with total>0. Deep pagination (page=30) returns 200. No 500s observed.

frontend HeaderNav.js: on 1920px viewport nav links group at x=(~400–920), and the language switcher + theme + login + register cluster on the right (x=1190–1576). Gap between language switcher and login = 71px — well within one visual group. ✅

Reusable regression test: /app/backend/tests/test_iter25.py (8 tests: photo dedup on 42259236, dedup on 6+ random cars, mercedes-heavy relevant spread, hyundai/kia-heavy relevant spread, empty-taste cold start, deep pagination, tracking +3d/+7d country-only, jsoncargo cache no-upstream). Sort dropdown is a native <select data-testid=sort-select> — Playwright must use `page.select_option(..., value='relevant')`, NOT clicking role=option. Track summary card at TrackPage.js:401-409 needs the container line hidden when by='bol'.
rca of the issue: TrackPage.js renders `data.container` unconditionally whenever it differs from `data.reference` — the by-mode is not consulted. When the buyer looks up by Bill of Lading, backend still returns the container number (needed for JSONCargo cache key and for the map) but the UI should treat it as private. Fix: wrap the block in `data.by !== 'bol' && data.container && ...` or drop entirely so the buyer never sees the container ID.
